name: privacy-layer-sdk
description: Arcane privacy layer TypeScript SDK monorepo

scripts.typecheck:deps: npm run build --workspace @arcanetech/privacy-sdk-core && npm run build --workspace @arcanetech/privacy-sdk-state-memory && npm run build --workspace @arcanetech/privacy-sdk-state-redux && npm run bindings:build --workspace @arcanetech/privacy-sdk-stellar
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run fallow:dead-code && npm run fallow:dupes
